newsitem.title: UK: FNB unit Henry Ansbacher's profit rises.
newsitem.headline: FNB unit Henry Ansbacher's profit rises.

text.p: Henry Ansbacher Group, the London merchant banking arm of South Africa's First National Bank Holdings, said on Sunday that pretax profit in the year ended September 30, 1996 rose to 10.757 million pounds ($18.07 million) from 5.525 million pounds in the prior year.
"The United Kingdom-based merchant banking operations achieved a particularly satisfying improvement in performance," the bank said in a statement.
"The offshore operations continue to perform strongly. The Bahamas operation and the Jersey operation (the latter acquired in April 1995) recorded especially pleasing results," it said.
The bank said the latest result included a pretax contribution of 1.085 million stg from FNB (Asia) Limited, which was transferred to the Henry Ansbacher Group on January 1, 1996.

"Henry Ansbacher's South African financing activities, while also experiencing pressure on margins, have nevertheless had a very satisfactory year," the bank said. "The group has maintained a strong liquidity position throughout the year. Customer deposits have risen by almost 100 million sterling."
